## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it belongs in Kr8 Studio.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run audit:public`

## Compatibility

- [ ] Existing `.kr8` projects remain loadable.
- [ ] Unknown project fields and stable IDs are preserved.
- [ ] Optional services remain optional.

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private paths, protected media, models, generated exports, or populated environment files are included.
- [ ] No global process termination is used.

Substantial external contributions can be deferred until the project approves
the contributor-permission model described in
`CONTRIBUTOR-LICENSE-AGREEMENT-DECISION.md`. This template is not a CLA and does
not create a copyright assignment or separate relicensing grant.
